expected_effect: Direction: lower val_bpb. Size: training steps in 1800 s rise from ~2073 to >=2180 (>=+5%); final public val_bpb falls from ~1.0059 to <=1.0025 (-0.003 to -0.010). Falsified if steps <= 2080 or val_bpb >= 1.0055 with seed 42 at the same shape.
hypothesis: At the default (record-config) shape on 9a4caa7b the 1800 s budget yields only ~2071-2076 optimizer steps (controls 1.005734 / 1.005967 BPB). Routing attention through the directly compiled SDPA path (--compile-sdpa-direct) removes the slower default attention graph without changing numerics policy (FP32 SDPA inputs, FP32 norm outputs, FP32 residuals are untouched), so the same seed-42 schedule completes more steps inside the fixed wall clock and reaches a lower final val_bpb. The fresh-start ledger shows the direct-SDPA FP32 width-896 run (fs-w3) completed 2188 steps, more than the width-896 run without direct SDPA even when that run had BF16 matmul autocast (fs-w896-bf16, 2026 steps), and every subsequent fresh-start improvement retained the flag explicitly, which is consistent with it being off by default and being a pure throughput lever.
single_causal_change: Enable --compile-sdpa-direct only; all other flags remain at the 9a4caa7b defaults used by the two controls (no bf16-sdpa-input, no bf16-norm-output, no nki-local-conv, no optimizer/schedule/shape change).
